status: Post hoc sensitivity motivated by stronger-model forecasts omitting the resting baseline. Frozen primary metrics unchanged.

definitions.raw_response: Unclipped prediction minus its zero-shock prediction at the corresponding horizon.
definitions.relative_vector_exact_01: All eight raw response coordinates within 0.01 of simulator response.
definitions.global_offset_corrected_level_mae: Add baseline minus mean(predicted zero-shock values at h1 and h3) to every forecast before MAE.
definitions.horizon_offset_corrected_level_mae: Add baseline minus predicted zero-shock value separately within each horizon; equals .8 times raw-response MAE.
definitions.zero_shock_offset: Predicted zero-shock forecast minus true domain resting level; negative baseline indicates omission.
definitions.selection: Selection-only uses no forecasts and is excluded from this numerical audit.
